Jabil raised FY2026 revenue/EPS guidance on extremely strong AI infrastructure demand, lifted AI-related revenue to about $13.6B, and added an India AI-rack/power manufacturing platform with Adani. Crowding remains, but fundamentals outran prior expectations.
